ddl.name: messages_check_3
ddl.value: recording_id IS NULL OR recording_ms IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: practice_questions_check_10
ddl.value: (choice IS NOT NULL) = (answered_at IS NOT NULL AND kind = 'choice')

ddl.name: practice_questions_check_11
ddl.value: (answer IS NOT NULL) = (answered_at IS NOT NULL AND kind = 'open')

ddl.name: jobs_check_3
ddl.value:
(source_id IS NOT NULL) + (document_id IS NOT NULL) + (session_id IS NOT NULL)
        + (message_id IS NOT NULL) + (artifact_id IS NOT NULL) + (question_id IS NOT NULL) = 1

ddl.name: jobs_kind_target_check
ddl.value:
(kind IN ('fetch', 'extract') AND source_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind = 'index' AND document_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind = 'title' AND session_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind IN ('reply', 'rewrite') AND message_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind = 'artifact' AND artifact_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind IN ('question', 'grade') AND question_id IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: material_versions_status_check
ddl.value: status IN ('draft','published') AND ((status = 'published') = (published_at IS NOT NULL))

ddl.name: material_versions_language_check
ddl.value: language IS NULL OR length(trim(language)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64

ddl.name: material_versions_instruction_check
ddl.value: instruction IS NULL OR length(trim(instruction)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100000

ddl.name: material_versions_times_check
ddl.value: typeof(created_at) = 'integer' AND created_at >= 0 AND (published_at IS NULL OR (typeof(published_at) = 'integer' AND published_at >= created_at))

ddl.name: materials_times_check
ddl.value: id > 0 AND typeof(created_at) = 'integer' AND typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND created_at >= 0 AND updated_at >= created_at AND (archived_at IS NULL OR (typeof(archived_at) = 'integer' AND archived_at >= created_at))

ddl.name: material_audio_duration_check
ddl.value: duration_ms IS NULL OR (typeof(duration_ms) = 'integer' AND duration_ms >= 0)

ddl.name: material_audio_sample_rate_check
ddl.value: sample_rate IS NULL OR (typeof(sample_rate) = 'integer' AND sample_rate > 0)

ddl.name: material_audio_channels_check
ddl.value: channels IS NULL OR (typeof(channels) = 'integer' AND channels > 0)

ddl.name: material_image_dimensions_check
ddl.value: (width IS NULL AND height IS NULL) OR (width IS NOT NULL AND height IS NOT NULL AND typeof(width) = 'integer' AND typeof(height) = 'integer' AND width > 0 AND height > 0)

ddl.name: material_version_citations_anchor_check
ddl.value:
CASE WHEN json_valid("anchor") THEN coalesce(
    json_type("anchor") = 'object' AND CASE json_extract("anchor", '$.type')
    WHEN 'time' THEN json_type("anchor", '$.startMs') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.startMs') >= 0
      AND json_type("anchor", '$.endMs') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.endMs') >= json_extract("anchor", '$.startMs')
    WHEN 'page' THEN json_type("anchor", '$.page') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.page') >= 1
    WHEN 'paragraph' THEN json_type("anchor", '$.index') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.index') >= 0
    WHEN 'slide' THEN json_type("anchor", '$.index') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.index') >= 0
    WHEN 'url' THEN json_type("anchor", '$.url') = 'text' AND length(trim(json_extract("anchor", '$.url'))) > 0
      AND json_type("anchor", '$.fragment') IN ('null', 'text')
    WHEN 'text' THEN json_type("anchor", '$.lineStart') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.lineStart') >= 0
      AND json_type("anchor", '$.lineEnd') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.lineEnd') >= json_extract("anchor", '$.lineStart')
      AND json_type("anchor", '$.start') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.start') >= 0
      AND json_type("anchor", '$.end') = 'integer' AND json_extract("anchor", '$.end') >= json_extract("anchor", '$.start')
    ELSE 0 END, 0) ELSE 0 END

ddl.name: material_video_duration_check
ddl.value: duration_ms IS NULL OR (typeof(duration_ms) = 'integer' AND duration_ms >= 0)

ddl.name: material_video_dimensions_check
ddl.value: (width IS NULL AND height IS NULL) OR (width IS NOT NULL AND height IS NOT NULL AND typeof(width) = 'integer' AND typeof(height) = 'integer' AND width > 0 AND height > 0)

ddl.name: material_card_reviews_values
ddl.value: typeof(reviewed_at) = 'integer' AND reviewed_at >= 0 AND rating IN ('again','hard','good','easy') AND elapsed_days >= 0

ddl.name: material_card_schedules_values
ddl.value: typeof(due) = 'integer' AND due >= 0 AND state IN ('new','learning','review','relearning') AND stability >= 0 AND stability <= 36500 AND difficulty BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND typeof(reps) = 'integer' AND typeof(lapses) = 'integer' AND reps >= 0 AND lapses BETWEEN 0 AND reps AND (last_review IS NULL OR (typeof(last_review) = 'integer' AND last_review >= 0)) AND typeof(elapsed_days) = 'integer' AND elapsed_days >= 0 AND typeof(scheduled_days) = 'integer' AND scheduled_days >= 0 AND typeof(learning_steps) = 'integer' AND learning_steps >= 0

ddl.name: material_flashcard_entries_values
ddl.value: typeof(position) = 'integer' AND typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0 AND length(trim(front)) > 0 AND length(trim(back)) > 0

ddl.name: material_quiz_attempts_values
ddl.value: status IN ('in_progress','completed') AND typeof(started_at) = 'integer' AND started_at >= 0 AND (finished_at IS NULL OR (typeof(finished_at) = 'integer' AND finished_at >= started_at)) AND ((status = 'completed' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'in_progress' AND finished_at IS NULL))

ddl.name: material_quiz_choices_values
ddl.value: question_kind IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice') AND typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0 AND length(trim(text)) > 0 AND is_correct IN (0,1)

ddl.name: material_quiz_questions_values
ddl.value: typeof(position) = 'integer' AND typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0 AND kind IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','open') AND length(trim(prompt)) > 0 AND length(trim(explanation)) > 0

ddl.name: material_quiz_responses_values
ddl.value: question_kind IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','open') AND (score IS NULL OR score BETWEEN 0 AND 1) AND ((question_kind = 'open' AND answer IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(answer)) > 0) OR (question_kind IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice') AND answer IS NULL))
